messages:
Maya: FYI merchant TileWorks (merchant_id: TW-993) reports recurring autopay failures for PO INV-7924. Server logs show mixed declines: `insufficient_funds` and occasional `challenge_required` from issuer. Manual charge succeeded once. Can payments team triage?

Devin: Can you paste the raw gateway responses + trace_id and confirm if autopay attempts are `off_session=true`?

Maya: trace_id: 1712348000-abc; card: **** **** **** 4242; excerpt from gateway:

```
{"status":"declined","issuer_response":"insufficient_funds","three_ds":"redirect_to_acs","acs_url":"https://acs.bankxyz.com/frm","code":"51"}
```
We also intermittently see:

```
{"status":"declined","issuer_response":"challenge_required","three_ds":"iframe_challenge","code":"CH_401"}
```

Ana: Merchant-side console shows `Blocked third-party cookie` + `Refused to display '<frame>' in a frame because it set 'X-Frame-Options' or Content-Security-Policy.` Which browsers?

Maya: Chrome 111 and 115 reported. Merchant confirms ACS is embedded in an invoice iframe on their site; autopay is intended to be invisible to payer.

Devin: That explains it. If ACS expects a top-level navigation for the challenge, embedding in a third-party iframe will break when browsers block third-party cookies or require top-level context. For off-session autopay we expect frictionless or `requires_action` which should surface to merchant. Do we currently surface an `action_required` webhook for these autopay failures?

Liam: Not reliably. Our routing for autopay marks these as terminal declines in some cases. We do have a hosted challenge link generator but it isn't wired into autopay fallback. Quick mitigation: flip a flag to emit `payment.action_required` with `acs_url` for failing autopays for 24h while merchant tests.

Maya: Merchant wants an immediate workaround. Can we retry with `off_session=false` so the user is prompted? They prefer no user interaction.

Devin: `off_session=false` will surface the challenge UI to the payer in-session, which isn't suitable for scheduled autopay. Better short-term: emit a hosted challenge link in the webhook/email so payer can complete the challenge via top-level navigation. Long-term: recommend merchant switch to redirect flow or host ACS on a top-level domain so cookies aren't third-party. Also ensure ACS cookies use `SameSite=None; Secure` and merchant whitelists ACS domains.

Maya: I've filed support ticket #2345 and sent the hosted challenge link to merchant. Asked them to whitelist `acs.bankxyz.com` and test. They'll try tonight and report back.

Ana: I'll open an internal ops ticket to add monitoring for `challenge_required` rates and to add a short-term route that surfaces the `acs_url` in a `payment.action_required` webhook.

Devin: I'll draft a small runtime patch to emit `payment.action_required` with an `acs_url` and a 24h retry window before marking the autopay failed. Deployed to staging for validation.

Maya: Thanks all. Merchant will test tonight; keeping support ticket open. Closing this Slack thread — will reopen if declines persist. :white_check_mark:
